# Cryo

> Cryo is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted Apache Iceberg maintenance control plane. Connect your lake and keep every table healthy without deciding when or how to optimize it — Cryo grades every table, runs the work on your Trino or Spark, and explains every decision.

Cryo reads Apache Iceberg catalogs, grades every table from its metadata, and runs the maintenance on the Trino or Spark you already have when they have headroom (both GA; a native Go compactor is beta and opt-in). Ranking by real query workload needs query-log ingestion. Sources and engines stay separate. The planner emits no SQL. Every decision is explained. These pages are the public docs.

Read this file, then answer only from the pages below. If a fact is not on one of them, say so.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/index.md): Self-hosted Apache Iceberg maintenance. Reads catalogs, plans the work, admits it when the engine has headroom.
- [Quickstart](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/quickstart/index.md): Clone the repo, run ./start-local.sh start, open localhost:5173, then add a source and run the first scan.
- [Benchmark](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/benchmark/index.md): Measured results: Cryo versus scheduled and hand-run Spark on fleet health, a 100 GiB table, live CDC and query impact, with trade-offs.
- [Connect a lakehouse](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/onboarding/index.md): Connect a REST, Hive Metastore, Glue, Polaris or Nessie catalog to Cryo, choose S3 credentials, and run the first scan. Covers every field, what the scan reads, and the failures that look like success.
- [How Cryo fits](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/concepts/index.md): A source is where a table lives. A destination is where maintenance runs. Cryo holds the plan between them.
- [Architecture](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/architecture/index.md): Catalogs on the read side, engines on the write side, and the planner in between.
- [Maintenance](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/maintenance/index.md): Compact first, then clean up, in one fixed order no preset can change.
- [Health and cost](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/health/index.md): Grades run from A to F. A warning costs 8 points and a critical finding costs 20.
- [Tables](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/tables/index.md): A guided tour of Cryo's Tables page, covering the triage cards, the nightly maintenance funnel, the catalog list, quick views, filters, columns, the savings view and bulk actions.
- [Table detail](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/table-detail/index.md): A guided tour of Cryo's table detail page, covering the header, the actions menu and table settings, plus every section of the Overview, Schema & files, Snapshots, Maintenance, Config, Usage, Quality and Cost & Savings tabs, including archiving cold partitions.
- [Engines](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/engines/index.md): The planner emits no SQL. Trino and Spark each render the same plan in their own dialect.
- [Deployment](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/deployment/index.md): Helm on Kubernetes. Cryo plans and admits; Trino and Spark stay where they already run.
- [Install on Kubernetes](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/install/index.md): Production Helm install for Cryo. Prerequisites, the Secret, a secure values file, helm upgrade --install, migrations, verification, upgrade and uninstall.
- [Security](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/security/index.md): Cryo authentication and production hardening. OIDC setup and role claims, the viewer, operator and admin roles, the dev token, CRYO_SECRET_KEY, stored credentials, egress, and a hardening checklist.
- [Upgrade and rollback](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/upgrade/index.md): How to upgrade a Cryo Helm release, how the migration hook behaves, and what a rollback can and can't undo.
- [Backup and restore](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/backup/index.md): What Cryo stores where, encrypted PostgreSQL backups with the built-in tool or the backup CronJob, a restore procedure, and what losing Redis costs.
- [Configuration reference](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/configuration/index.md): The full configuration reference for Cryo -- CRYO_* environment variables and deploy/helm/cryo values.
- [Troubleshooting](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/troubleshooting/index.md): Symptom-first troubleshooting for Cryo installs, sign-in, scans, runs, deferred jobs and Spark lanes, plus an FAQ.
- [Reference](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/reference/index.md): What is in the box, what is not, and how Cryo compares with adjacent tools.
- [Changelog](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/changelog/index.md): Cryo's changelog, rendered from CHANGELOG.md, with links to the versioning and support policies.
- [Contributing](https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/contributing/index.md): How to set up a Cryo development environment, run the tests and the docs build, and get a pull request merged.

Full index: https://tech-pw.github.io/cryo/llms.txt
